One page per task. Pages built from the standard task report (Hearts and
Flowers, Math) share the same sections, all computed from the pinned
release: deployment and forms, coverage, the item bank, item health,
scores, reliability, stability and validity, and time, followed by a
section specific to the task and its open issues. The other pages predate
the template and are being moved onto it. Analyses of Same & Different,
Stories, ROAR-Word and ROAR-Sentence are in [Studies](../studies/index.qmd).
